t: Mapei Mapesil AC 113 is a high-performance, solvent-free silicone sealant, ideal for comprehensive sealing applications in both interior and exterior environments. This waterproof and mould-resistant sanitary sealant ensures durable finishes around wash basins, bath tubs, and shower trays. Its robust formulation is also suitable for window frames, providing chemical and mildew resistance for lasting protection. With a maximum heat resistance of 180°C, it is a reliable solution for various trade projects, including those requiring underwater application. The cement grey colour coordinates seamlessly with the Mapei Ultracolour Plus Grout range, offering a professional and uniform aesthetic.
b: Suitable for Sanitaryware, Wash Basins, Bath Tubs, Shower Trays & Window Frames
